mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tickets (title, description, creator_id, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{description,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{creatorId}, #{status})

choose.otherwise: ((status = 'OPEN' AND assignee_id IS NULL) OR assignee_id = #{actorId})

mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, creator_id, assignee_id, status FROM tickets WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
